title: a cited record whose holder's link prefills nothing is an assisted search, off the fetch list
line: an application of the Sons of the American Revolution is held for free at the SAR Patriot Research System, whose form posts and whose link carries nothing of the citation: its step is a fetch planned assisted, the citation's own fields as what to look for, never on the fetch list, and its log stays through a re-plan; a citation at a holder whose link carries the citation stays a fetch on the list, and one at a holder with a connector stays a fetch the runner takes

steps.say: Elizabeth D'Armand's one citation is a Sons of the American Revolution application, the SAR Patriot Research System its free holder

collection.value: U.S., Sons of the American Revolution Membership Applications, 1889-1970

has: searched by hand at SAR Patriot Research System

expect.why: the holder's link is the same form whatever the citation says, so the step is an assisted search carrying the citation's own details, not a fetch
an empty form is no page to save: the fetch list never names it
only a hand can take the search: it is counted with the assisted searches

steps.say: Noi Davidson's Legacy Funeral's citation is at Legacy.com, whose search link takes the name from the citation

expect.why: the link carries the citation's name, so the step stays a fetch
a page the citation prefills stays on the fetch list

steps.say: Noi Davidson's veterans' gravesites citation is at the VA gravesite locator, a holder with a connector and no search link of its own

expect.why: the runner asks the holder by the citation's fields and never by its link, so the step stays a fetch for the runner
a holder with a connector is never on the fetch list

steps.say: the search is run by hand and found nothing, then the plan is made again

log.note: harness: searched by the patriot's name at the holder's page, no match

expect.why: a re-plan keeps the step assisted
the run is logged at the holder like any assisted search and the re-plan keeps it
still not a page to fetch

steps.say: a turn on Elizabeth D'Armand has no page to pause on

expect.why: the turn kept no state: it paused on no page, for the search form is never offered as a page to save
the search is left for a hand, named among the planned steps the turn cannot take
the turn leaves the assisted search planned: it waits for a hand, not the loop
